summary: A talking spelling game modelled on the 1978 Speak & Spell, with an LPC speech voice, an imitation fluorescent display and the original game types, in English.
features: SPELL, LETTER, SAY IT, SECRET CODE and MYSTERY WORD games
100 words across 4 levels; keys laid out alphabetically
"SING" and "LETTER SYNTH" turn words and letters into playable notes
"SPEAK" reads typed text using a 12,000-word dictionary
Circuit-bending settings: clock, pitch, corrupted coefficients, stutter, crush
Voice made with espeak-ng, no original ROM data; README in French

headings: spellbox — jeu d'orthographe parlant pour m-vave fm-1
